import Mathlib

structure DFSGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def DFSGraph.well_formed (g : DFSGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def DFSGraph.size (g : DFSGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def DFSGraph.has_edge (g : DFSGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def DFSGraph.is_path (g : DFSGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def DFSGraph.reachable (g : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some target

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dfs_check_reachability_precond (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧ start < graph.size ∧ target < graph.size
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- One step of an explicit-stack depth first search.  `st` is the DFS stack
(top of the stack first), `vis` the set of already expanded nodes.  The search
stops as soon as `target` is popped from the stack. -/
def dfsAux (adj : Array (Array Nat)) (target : Nat) (st : List Nat)
    (vis : Finset Nat) : Bool :=
  match st with
  | [] => false
  | u :: st' =>
    if u = target then true
    else if h : u < adj.size ∧ u ∉ vis then
      dfsAux adj target ((adj.getD u #[]).toList ++ st') (insert u vis)
    else
      dfsAux adj target st' vis
termination_by ((Finset.range adj.size \ vis).card, st.length)
decreasing_by
  · apply Prod.Lex.left
    have hsub : Finset.range adj.size \ insert u vis ⊆ Finset.range adj.size \ vis :=
      Finset.sdiff_subset_sdiff (Finset.Subset.refl _) (Finset.subset_insert u vis)
    refine Finset.card_lt_card ((Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset hsub).mpr ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩)
    · simp [Finset.mem_sdiff, h.1, h.2]
    · simp
  · apply Prod.Lex.right
    simp
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def dfs_check_reachability (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  dfsAux graph.adj target [start] ∅
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def dfs_check_reachability_postcond (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) (result : Bool)
    (_ : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result = graph.reachable start target
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem path_to_rtg (g : DFSGraph) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (a b : Nat), g.is_path p → p.head? = some a →
      p.getLast? = some b → Relation.ReflTransGen g.has_edge a b := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro a b _ hh _; simp at hh
  | cons x p ih =>
    intro a b hp hh hl
    simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hh
    subst hh
    cases p with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hl
      subst hl
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | cons y q =>
      have hedge : g.has_edge x y := by
        have := hp.2 0 (by simp)
        simpa using this
      have hp' : g.is_path (y :: q) := by
        refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        have hlt : i + 1 + 1 < (x :: y :: q).length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
          omega
        have := hp.2 (i + 1) hlt
        simpa using this
      have hl' : (y :: q).getLast? = some b := by
        rw [← hl, List.getLast?_cons_cons]
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head hedge (ih y b hp' rfl hl')

theorem rtg_to_reachable (g : DFSGraph) (a b : Nat)
    (h : Relation.ReflTransGen g.has_edge a b) : g.reachable a b := by
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl =>
    refine ⟨[b], ⟨by simp, ?_⟩, by simp, by simp⟩
    intro i hi
    simp at hi
  | head hac _ ih =>
    rename_i x c _
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := ih
    cases p with
    | nil => simp at hh
    | cons y q =>
      simp only [List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq] at hh
      subst hh
      refine ⟨x :: y :: q, ⟨by simp, ?_⟩, by simp, ?_⟩
      · intro i hi
        cases i with
        | zero => simpa using hac
        | succ j =>
          have hlt : j + 1 < (y :: q).length := by
            simp only [List.length_cons] at hi ⊢
            omega
          have := hp.2 j hlt
          simpa using this
      · rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]
        exact hl

theorem dfsAux_sound (g : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat) :
    ∀ (st : List Nat) (vis : Finset Nat),
      (∀ u ∈ st, Relation.ReflTransGen g.has_edge start u) →
      dfsAux g.adj target st vis = true →
      Relation.ReflTransGen g.has_edge start target := by
  intro st vis
  induction st, vis using dfsAux.induct (adj := g.adj) (target := target) with
  | case1 vis => intro _ hf; rw [dfsAux] at hf; exact absurd hf (by simp)
  | case2 vis st' =>
    intro hinv _
    exact hinv target (by simp)
  | case3 vis u st' hne h ih =>
    intro hinv hf
    refine ih ?_ ?_
    · intro w hw
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hw with hw' | hw'
      · have hu : Relation.ReflTransGen g.has_edge start u := hinv u (by simp)
        refine hu.tail ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
        simpa using hw'
      · exact hinv w (by simp [hw'])
    · rw [dfsAux] at hf
      rw [if_neg hne, dif_pos h] at hf
      exact hf
  | case4 vis u st' hne h ih =>
    intro hinv hf
    refine ih (fun w hw => hinv w (by simp [hw])) ?_
    rw [dfsAux] at hf
    rw [if_neg hne, dif_neg h] at hf
    exact hf

theorem dfsAux_complete (adj : Array (Array Nat)) (target : Nat) :
    ∀ (st : List Nat) (vis : Finset Nat),
      (∀ u ∈ vis, ∀ v ∈ adj.getD u #[], v ∈ vis ∨ v ∈ st ∨ adj.size ≤ v) →
      target ∉ vis →
      dfsAux adj target st vis = false →
      ∃ V : Finset Nat, vis ⊆ V ∧ (∀ u ∈ st, u ∈ V ∨ adj.size ≤ u) ∧ target ∉ V ∧
        ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ v ∈ adj.getD u #[], v ∈ V ∨ adj.size ≤ v := by
  intro st vis
  induction st, vis using dfsAux.induct (adj := adj) (target := target) with
  | case1 vis =>
    intro hcl htg _
    refine ⟨vis, subset_rfl, by simp, htg, ?_⟩
    intro u hu v hv
    rcases hcl u hu v hv with h1 | h1 | h1
    · exact Or.inl h1
    · simp at h1
    · exact Or.inr h1
  | case2 vis st' =>
    intro _ _ hf
    rw [dfsAux, if_pos rfl] at hf
    exact absurd hf (by simp)
  | case3 vis u st' hne h ih =>
    intro hcl htg hf
    have hcl' : ∀ w ∈ insert u vis, ∀ v ∈ adj.getD w #[],
        v ∈ insert u vis ∨ v ∈ (adj.getD u #[]).toList ++ st' ∨ adj.size ≤ v := by
      intro w hw v hv
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hw with rfl | hw'
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl (by simpa using hv))))
      · rcases hcl w hw' v hv with h1 | h1 | h1
        · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h1)
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h1 with rfl | h2
          · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr h2)))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h1)
    have htg' : target ∉ insert u vis := by
      intro hc
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hc with rfl | hc'
      · exact hne rfl
      · exact htg hc'
    have hf' : dfsAux adj target ((adj.getD u #[]).toList ++ st') (insert u vis) = false := by
      rw [dfsAux] at hf
      rw [if_neg hne, dif_pos h] at hf
      exact hf
    obtain ⟨V, hsub, hst, htV, hclV⟩ := ih hcl' htg' hf'
    refine ⟨V, (Finset.subset_insert u vis).trans hsub, ?_, htV, hclV⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with rfl | hw'
    · exact Or.inl (hsub (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
    · exact hst w (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hw'))
  | case4 vis u st' hne h ih =>
    intro hcl htg hf
    have hu : u ∈ vis ∨ adj.size ≤ u := by
      by_cases hlt : u < adj.size
      · left
        by_contra hc
        exact h ⟨hlt, hc⟩
      · right; omega
    have hcl' : ∀ w ∈ vis, ∀ v ∈ adj.getD w #[], v ∈ vis ∨ v ∈ st' ∨ adj.size ≤ v := by
      intro w hw v hv
      rcases hcl w hw v hv with h1 | h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inl h1
      · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h1 with rfl | h2
        · rcases hu with hu' | hu'
          · exact Or.inl hu'
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inr hu')
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h2)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h1)
    have hf' : dfsAux adj target st' vis = false := by
      rw [dfsAux] at hf
      rw [if_neg hne, dif_neg h] at hf
      exact hf
    obtain ⟨V, hsub, hst, htV, hclV⟩ := ih hcl' htg hf'
    refine ⟨V, hsub, ?_, htV, hclV⟩
    intro w hw
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with rfl | hw'
    · rcases hu with hu' | hu'
      · exact Or.inl (hsub hu')
      · exact Or.inr hu'
    · exact hst w hw'

theorem closed_rtg (g : DFSGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) (V : Finset Nat)
    (hcl : ∀ u ∈ V, ∀ v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[], v ∈ V ∨ g.adj.size ≤ v)
    (a b : Nat) (h : Relation.ReflTransGen g.has_edge a b) (ha : a ∈ V) : b ∈ V := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ha
  | @tail x y hxy hyz ih =>
    rcases hcl x ih y hyz.2 with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd (hwf x hyz.1 y hyz.2) (by omega)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem dfs_check_reachability_postcond_satisfied (graph : DFSGraph) (start target : Nat)
    (h_precond : dfs_check_reachability_precond graph start target) :
    dfs_check_reachability_postcond graph start target
      (dfs_check_reachability graph start target h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hwf, hs, ht⟩ := h_precond
  simp only [dfs_check_reachability_postcond, dfs_check_reachability, eq_iff_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hT
    refine rtg_to_reachable graph start target ?_
    refine dfsAux_sound graph start target [start] ∅ ?_ hT
    intro u hu
    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hu
    subst hu
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  · intro hR
    by_contra hne
    have hf : dfsAux graph.adj target [start] ∅ = false := by
      simpa using hne
    obtain ⟨V, _, hst, htV, hclV⟩ :=
      dfsAux_complete graph.adj target [start] ∅ (by simp) (by simp) hf
    have hstV : start ∈ V := by
      rcases hst start (by simp) with h1 | h1
      · exact h1
      · exact absurd hs (by simp only [DFSGraph.size]; omega)
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl⟩ := hR
    exact htV (closed_rtg graph hwf V hclV start target
      (path_to_rtg graph p start target hp hh hl) hstV)
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## What was implemented

**Algorithm** (`auxcode`) — a genuine explicit-stack DFS:

```lean
def dfsAux (adj) (target) (st : List Nat) (vis : Finset Nat) : Bool :=
  match st with
  | [] => false
  | u :: st' =>
    if u = target then true
    else if h : u < adj.size ∧ u ∉ vis then
      dfsAux adj target ((adj.getD u #[]).toList ++ st') (insert u vis)   -- LIFO push
    else dfsAux adj target st' vis
termination_by ((Finset.range adj.size \ vis).card, st.length)
```

`dfs_check_reachability` = `dfsAux graph.adj target [start] ∅`. It is total and does not consult `h_precond`.

**Termination** (challenge 3): well-founded recursion on the lexicographic pair *(number of unvisited nodes in range, stack length)* — expanding a node strictly shrinks `range n \ vis`; popping an already-visited/out-of-range node shrinks the stack. No fuel, no `partial`.

**Proofs** (`lemma`/`proof`):
- `path_to_rtg` / `rtg_to_reachable`: the index-based `is_path` spec is equivalent to `Relation.ReflTransGen has_edge` (prepend construction for the backward direction).
- `dfsAux_sound` (challenge 1): invariant "every node on the stack is reachable from `start`"; a `true` result comes from popping `target`, yielding a real edge path.
- `dfsAux_complete` (challenge 2): invariant "for every expanded `u`, each neighbour is visited, on the stack, or out of range", plus `target ∉ vis`. By functional induction a `false` result produces an edge-closed set `V` containing `start` but not `target`.
- `closed_rtg`: with `well_formed` (which rules out the out-of-range case), closure propagates along any path, so `target ∈ V` — contradiction.

## Semantic audit

- Both directions of the postcondition `(result = true) = graph.reachable start target` are proved; no oracle, brute force, `Nat.find`, `Classical.choose`, or `decide` on the target property.
- Preconditions: `well_formed` is used in `closed_rtg`; `start < graph.size` is used to place `start` in `V`. `target < graph.size` is available but not needed (the proof is strictly stronger without it).
- Edge case `start = target`: returns `true`, and `[start]` is a valid path (`is_path` holds vacuously), so the postcondition is satisfied. Cycles are handled by the visited set; self-loops and out-of-range adjacency entries are covered by the `n ≤ v` disjunct in the invariant.
- All four markers preserved; no `sorry`/`admit`/`axiom`/`partial`/`unsafe` in editable sections; helper definitions are real (no `:= 0` or `:= True` placeholders).
